# GM Dental & Implant Centre — Cosmetic Dentistry & Invisalign (Rochester)

GM Dental & Implant Centre is a private dental clinic in Rochester, Kent, UK. This page presents its cosmetic dentistry treatments and the current Invisalign offer for the Rochester clinic.

## What visitors can do on this page
- Enquire about cosmetic dentistry or Invisalign and request a free initial consultation (including a smile simulation) via the enquiry form.
- Explore treatments: Invisalign clear aligners, teeth whitening, composite bonding, veneers, smile makeovers and cosmetic crowns.
- See genuine before-and-after patient photos and two genuine patient video testimonials.
- Read the patient journey (enquiry, goals discussion, clinical assessment, options and costs, agreed treatment plan) and a ten-question FAQ.
- Contact the clinic by phone or WhatsApp, or book through the enquiry form.

## Sections
- Hero: cosmetic dentistry introduction with consultation booking form.
- Invisalign offer: confirmed Rochester package pricing, free initial assessment, finance example and supporting options.
- Results: interactive before-and-after sliders of real patients.
- Treatments: explanation of each cosmetic option.
- Patient journey: five steps from enquiry to agreed treatment plan.
- Clinic: real photography and film of the Rochester clinic and its Invisalign Zone.
- Testimonials: genuine patient videos.
- FAQ: common questions on treatments, costs, finance and the first appointment.

Treatment suitability, costs and outcomes depend on a clinical assessment and vary between patients.
